name: buildcontext
description: Extract compact, AI-agent-optimized knowledge bases from codebases and refine Markdown context files.

buildcontext.outputFolder.description: Output folder path relative to workspace root (defaults to .buildcontext/kb/)

buildcontext.include.description: Additional glob patterns to include in scanning

buildcontext.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from scanning

buildcontext.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan per workspace

buildcontext.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum file size in KB to analyze

buildcontext.kb.targetTokensPerApp.description: Target token count per application KB markdown file

buildcontext.kb.hardCapTokensPerApp.description: Hard token cap per application KB markdown file

buildcontext.kb.maxKeyComponents.description: Maximum number of key components listed per app

buildcontext.kb.includeGitHotspots.description: Include git commit frequency hotspots if available

buildcontext.refine.duplicateThreshold.description: Jaccard similarity threshold for near-duplicate section detection

buildcontext.refine.relatedThreshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold for related topic clustering

buildcontext.refine.targetTotalTokens.description: Optional overall token budget target for Refine Path

buildcontext.refine.backup.description: Create timestamped backup before modifying files in place

buildcontext.languages.enabled.description: List of language IDs to analyze (empty means all enabled)

buildcontext.customRulePacks.description: Paths to custom regex rule-pack JSON files

buildcontext.redactSecrets.description: Automatically redact potential API keys, passwords, and tokens

buildcontext.ai.provider.description: AI provider for Workspace AI and Refine Path AI

buildcontext.ai.model.description: AI model ID (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, llama3)

buildcontext.ai.endpoint.description: API endpoint URL for Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers

buildcontext.ai.maxTokensPerApp.description: Maximum input context tokens per app during AI generation

buildcontext.ai.maxTokensTotal.description: Maximum aggregate token budget for AI operations

buildcontext.ai.dryRun.description: Prompt for token estimate confirmation before invoking AI models

buildcontext.ai.useToolLoop.description: Allow AI model to use workspace-scoped read-only tools

buildcontext.ai.excludeFromAi.description: Globs of files never to send to AI models
